questions.question:

questions.question:
**Select the most appropriate option to fill in the blank.**

We must start now ______ it will be too late.
questions.solution:
The correct answer is **Or**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 Reading the above sentence we find that: 

__
 
• A **consequence of something not being done** is mentioned in the given line. 
 
• The correct conjunction to introduce such a consequence is **or**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/4f750a2730aad0987b5e719f277ddc90129c657928205c4d3b5aa23049023fa5.png] **Important Points__**

__
 
• **Or**: A conjunction that can be used to** introduce the consequences of something not being done or not being the case**

 
 
• **​****Example**: *Hurry up, or you'll miss it all.*
 
 
 
• *​*Thus from the above points, we can conclude that the correct answer here is **or**. 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Until**: A preposition and conjunction depending on the context, used to denote **up to the point in time or the event mentioned**.
 
• **Unless**: A conjunction used to denote **except if**. 
 
• **But**: A preposition and conjunction depending on the context used to denote **exceptions and contrast. **
